latency.scope: extraction plus baseline; not audio end-to-end

limitations: Template-generated fictional contract scenarios. Gold claims authored with the implementation; not independently annotated. Variants within a category are related, so the held_out split is a smoke-test partition, not evidence of out-of-distribution generalization.
Engine mode consumes gold structured claims. It does not measure speech recognition or language extraction.
Held-out template variants are related to development templates; independent scenario authoring is still required.
Human audio, user validation, semantic citation correctness, and answer coverage have not been measured.
Full-context LLM comparison requires authorized Bedrock access; no baseline score is invented.

errors.error: Bedrock is unavailable or this account lacks model access. Retry or review the note manually.
